changes.text: Google Calendar Connect is Calendar-only. Intranet Drive uses a separate consent so Google's consent page no longer returns Backend Error for some Workspace accounts.
Settings → General and Tyme tabs, with auto-save. Favorites are no longer cleared when saving Tyme settings.
Only Availability projects and optional remove of leftover Google events when a project stops syncing. Export-off keeps the GoogleEventId so turning export back on does not duplicate.
Resume live import when the push watch expired. Calendar reconnect messaging when Drive needs a separate reconnect or sync did not start.
All-day multi-day spans show inclusive dates and this week's hours (not 23:59). Week empty state is full width. Submitted-month dialog links to Submit.
Projects Download CSV of names and calendar slugs. Project name max length is 100.
LOCAL bar on localhost debug ports only (7047 / 5047 / 11256), with Hide 5 min.
Help → Availability covers manager-defined categories and Only Availability personal sync.
Product version display reset to 1.0.0 for this calendar/settings cluster.
